meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑出品牌片、蒙太奇、片头等各类自定义视频作品。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要灵活创作非模板化的自定义视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Produce and edit custom video pieces, from brand reels to montages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a flexible video creation tool for original, non-templated content.

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 编写或编辑自定义 HyperFrames 视频合成,适用于较长或多场景作品、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。它会先更新技能组件,读取项目状态和 BRIEF.md,生成计划、构建场景,并处理媒体与 Figma 输入。
howto.when: 当没有专用工作流适用,或 BRIEF.md 指定 flow: companion 时触发;典型用于制作较长或多场景视频、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇等。

say.text: 帮我做一个品牌宣传片,三个场景,半分钟。
say.note: 生成多场景计划并构建。

say.text: 把这段素材按硬切拆成三段并重新排序。
say.note: 复制视频源并设置片段范围。

say.text: 用伴生模式和我一起设计一个开场标题卡。
say.note: 进入 companion 流程共同创作。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude author or edit custom HyperFrames compositions for longer/multi-scene videos, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, and remixes. It updates the skill, reads project state, then plans and builds scenes while handling media and Figma inputs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Used for longer/multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds.

say_en.text: Help me make a brand reel with three scenes, 30 seconds.
say_en.note: Generates a multi-scene plan and builds it.

say_en.text: Split this footage into three hard-cut segments and reorder them.
say_en.note: Duplicates video sources and sets clip ranges.

say_en.text: Design an opening title card with me in companion mode.
